Weng.Modeler
Class DbProfile

  |

              +--Weng.Modeler.DbProfile
public class DbProfile
extends DbContainer

Use this class to create, query and manipulate a profile entity that resides in the modeler's database. A profile is an ordered sequence of curves.

Append

public boolean Append(DbCurve dbCurve)
Adds a curve entity to the end of this profile. Note that a curve entity can belong to only one profile.

Associate

public boolean Associate(double gapTol)
Forces adjacent curves in this profile to share common end points. Assuming we have an unassociated profile containing two curves, the profile will have four points. If the two of the curve end points overlap within the given gap tolerance, the equivalent associated profile will have only three points, introducing 'rubber band' behavior. If you modify the common end point, both curves will likewise be modified.

Disassociate

public boolean Disassociate()
Forces each curve in this profile to be unique and separate from its adjacent curves. Whereas the adjacent curves of an associated profile may reference common end points, the curves in an unassociated profile reference separate end points.

Reverse

public boolean Reverse()
Reverse the order and direction of curves in this profile.

Offset

public DbFeature Offset(int offsetDirection,
                        double offsetDistance,
                        double sharpAngle,
                        double zLevel)
Creates a feature containing one or more profiles, each profile containing offset curves derives from the curves of this profile.
Returns:
The result will normally contain only one profile, but certain geometric conditions can lead to a 'bifurcation' in the result. Regardless, each resulting profile will be devoid of 'loops'.

Dir

public int Dir()
Gets this signed direction of this profile.

Signed 'sense of direction' (+) CCW / (-) CW
Note that 'open' profiles can yield ambiguous results.
